violation_type.title: Screen Time Activities - Homework (26 TAC §744.2007(c))
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated during an unannounced monitoring inspection and found to be deficient when school aged children were observed using cell phones in the class for activities unrelated to homework or educational activities.

finding_variants.text: This standard was evaluated during an unannounced monitoring inspection and found to be deficient when school aged children were observed using cell phones in the class for activities unrelated to homework or educational activities.
Two school age children were observed playing games on their tablets not related to homework. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver asked the children to put their tablets away.

The caregiver asked children if they had their cell phones and proceeded to tell the children if they had cell phones to go to a specific table. The children were not doing homework and were watching videos. Note: I explained to the caregiver that unless the children are doing homework, cell phones were not allowed and he told the children to put the phones away.
